Name: Zerah, Son of Iddo
Summary: Son of Iddo and father of Jeaterai in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:21: Son of Iddo and father of Jeaterai in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
